subject: The one mistake that ruins 90% of weight loss plans
preview_text: I discovered this the hard way. Most users skip this step and wonder why their dog isn't losing weight.
body_paragraphs: I almost gave up on my own dog's weight loss journey because of this one thing. I was tracking everything, measuring meals, doing the walks. But the scale wouldn't budge. Turns out I was making the same mistake 9 out of 10 PupShape users make in their first week.

Here's the brutal truth: you can't out-exercise a bad diet. And the biggest diet mistake isn't the main meals—it's the treats. That little biscuit here, that cheese scrap there. It adds up to hundreds of hidden calories that completely sabotage your dog's progress. I've seen users follow perfect meal plans but still fail because they didn't track their treats.

That's why the Calorie Calculator for treats is the most important feature in the app. It takes 30 seconds to log what you give them. And once you see how those 'little' treats add up to an entire extra meal's worth of calories, everything changes. The math doesn't lie.

Open the app right now and tap the Calorie Calculator. Log just one treat you gave your dog today. See the numbers. Then imagine doing that for every treat, every day. That's the difference between watching your dog struggle and watching them thrive. P.S. The users who track treats for just 3 days straight see 40% better results in the first month. It's that powerful.
